id.description: Trigger Configuration ID. Use configuration discovery to find this value.

type.description: Trigger type: abandonedCart, abandonedSearch, productInterest, productCategoryInterest, contentCategoryInterest, userActivity, productChange, or variantChange.

name.description: Display name of the configured Trigger.

description.description: Description supplied for this Trigger configuration.

group.description: Optional configuration group; null when no group is assigned.

enabled.description: Whether this configuration is enabled. Trigger evaluation also requires the global configuration to be enabled.

within.description: Human-readable evaluation window. This is display text, not a machine-readable duration.

created.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created.

modified.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified.

withinMinutes.description: Evaluation window in minutes within which the Trigger criteria must be met. This is not necessarily the inactivity delay; consult the type-specific configuration and user conditions.

userConditionsJson.description: JSON-encoded array of Relewise user conditions, including activity and previous-trigger constraints. Parse this string as JSON and preserve $type metadata. Null when no condition collection is provided. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/triggers/user-conditions.html.

description: One Trigger configuration with typed criteria and scoped Relewise condition documents.
